item.description: Iran's new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, has vowed to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed as leverage against the United States and Israel, in his first public remarks since succeeding his father, Ali Khamenei. item.title: Ukraine opens battlefield data to train allies' AI systems
item.description: Ukraine has opened access to battlefield data for allied countries and companies to help train artificial intelligence systems used in drones, Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said on Thursday. The initiative allows partners to train AI models using large datasets collected during the war against Russia, including millions of annotated images and videos from combat drone missions. item.title: PEGI takes aim at loot boxes with adjusted regulations coming into place in June
item.description: In the coming months, there will be big changes to how PEGI (Pan European Game Information) rates any video game. The official body has announced that any titles that feature loot box mechanics will be rated 16 and up, with the specific wording expressing that these changes target "interactive risk" features. item.title: Honda cancels most upcoming EV's due to market conditions
item.description: Honda has abruptly pulled the plug on several major electric models, including the upcoming Acura RSX, as part of a broader rethink of its EV strategy, this has been announced by Honda themselves in a press release. The company confirmed it has stopped development of three planned models; the Honda 0 SUV, the Honda 0 Saloon, and the Acura-branded RSX crossover. item.title: Romania and Ukraine agree to joint defence production including drones
item.description: Romania and Ukraine have agreed to jointly produce Ukrainian defence systems, including drones, following a meeting in Bucharest between Presidents Nicușor Dan and Volodymyr Zelensky.
